outer_validation: Supplied five whole-MSA folds; Atlanta excluded
inner_validation: Leave out each supplied fold remaining inside the outer training set; five folds for final development-only tuning
tuning_metric: Equal-MSA count MAE, then RMSE, then candidate order
selection_rule: Minimum primary out-of-fold count MAE, then RMSE, then declared model order. Mean-count baseline is eligible. Main-effects ablations are diagnostic only.
preprocessing: Regression: training-fold median imputation, missing flags and standardization; B additionally training-fold one-hot categories. XGBoost: native numeric nulls, fold-fitted B one-hot categories. No feature selection or post-hoc probability calibration.
prevalence: Natural labels, no class weighting, undersampling or probability normalization
sensitivities: 35-input main-effects B logistic and XGBoost ablations; known Pittsburgh additional HQ shown as outcome-only scorecard context, without alternative model refits. Optional company financials and alternative targets are not fitted.
uncertainty: Percentile 95% intervals on fixed OOF predictions: resample whole metros for fixed-roster count metrics; additionally independently resample company and metro clusters for B count and probability metrics. No independent-Bernoulli intervals. These intervals omit model-refitting and selection uncertainty.
atlanta_band: Heuristic 90% empirical prediction band: final expected count plus/minus the finite-sample-adjusted 90th percentile of absolute development OOF count residuals, lower bound truncated at zero. Not a formal conformal interval or a confidence interval for the expected count.
